long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Beirut and raised between Kuwait and Lebanon, Khoury studied civil engineering in California before completing an MBA at the University of Southern California. He returned to the Gulf and took responsibility for CCC's Kuwait operations, later moving to its Athens headquarters. By 1997, he was overseeing marketing and execution across the group's international business.

Khoury's career combines operating responsibility with succession inside a family-owned enterprise. His father, Said Khoury, co-founded CCC, and the founding generation later handed the company to its successors. Samer became chief executive and now chairs the board, while a separate management team handles daily operations. Under his leadership, CCC has remained active in large engineering and construction programmes spanning energy, pipelines, transport, buildings and water. He has also supported education and employment initiatives in the Middle East.
